macros.name: letnamebookcovercomponenttype
macros.doc: With \letnamebookcovercomponenttype, ⟨new component type⟩ is defined using the current definition of ⟨defined component type⟩.

macros.name: letnamebookcoverpart
macros.doc: With \letnamebookcoverpart, ⟨new part⟩ is defined using the current definition of ⟨defined part⟩, with the specified margins applied.

macros.name: letnamebookcoverpart
macros.doc: With \letnamebookcoverpart, ⟨new part⟩ is defined using the current definition of ⟨defined part⟩, with the specified margins applied.

macros.name: newnamebookcovercomponenttype
macros.doc: With \newnamebookcovercomponenttype, ⟨new component type⟩ refers to the same definition as ⟨defined component type⟩ and follows any subsequent redefinition of that component type.

macros.name: newnamebookcoverpart
macros.doc: With \newnamebookcoverpart, ⟨new part⟩ refers to the same definition as ⟨defined part⟩ and follows any subsequent redefinition of that part.

macros.name: partheight
macros.doc: The height of the part (reduced by the margins) in which you are using the defined component type.
